content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a service that enables users to host websites directly from a GitHub repository. This means you can create a digital storefront for your products without the overhead costs associated with conventional platforms. Unlike services like Gumroad, which take a hefty cut of sales, GitHub Pages allows creators to retain full control of their earnings. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can sell ebooks, courses, and templates directly to their audience without worrying about high fees or restrictive payment policies.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a digital product store using GitHub Pages is both straightforward and powerful. You host your static website on GitHub Pages, which is free, and use backend logic through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage orders and automate delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the transaction in real-time, confirming payment on-chain. This entire setup ensures that creators can deliver products instantly while avoiding platform dependencies, making it an ideal solution for those in regions with limited payment options.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in markets where conventional payment systems are unavailable or heavily regulated. Whether you are selling ebooks in Kenya, templates in Pakistan, or beats in Nigeria, this solution provides a reliable way to monetize your work. By bypassing traditional platforms, creators can maintain complete ownership of their sales and data, ensuring they aren't beholden to any external service that could restrict their income or access at any moment.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments — significantly better than the 10% fees of platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. GitHub Pages allows for free hosting, while automation tools manage order fulfillment. NOWPayments processes over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee of just 0.5%, ensuring that creators keep most of their revenue. This combination of tools provides a seamless experience for both creators and buyers, enabling efficient transactions without relying on traditional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store, start by setting up a GitHub repository and creating your website using GitHub Pages. Next, integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend operations such as order processing and product delivery. Sign up for NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, load your products and start marketing your store. Each step is straightforward and can be accomplished within a few hours, empowering you to start generating revenue immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using GitHub Pages for hosting your digital store. Utilize tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions at minimal fees. This setup allows you to retain full control over your products and earnings.
Instant product delivery is possible through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers — streamline customer experience effortlessly.

Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic to automate order processing. Sign up for NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Load your digital products onto the site and test the payment flow. Finally, promote your store to your audience.
